verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents SAML-based SSO that lets users sign in to all their company's cloud apps with their managed Google account, which covers the 'sign in once' part of the story. The evidence never mentions an employee-facing launcher dashboard or a browser extension listing assigned apps. Missing for 10: employee app launcher/portal dashboard, browser extension, per-user assigned-app visibility, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an employee, one portal holds my work apps — a launcher dashboard (and browser extension) where I sign in once and reach everything I'm assigned

citations.quote: L'authentification unique (SSO) permet aux utilisateurs de se connecter à toutes les applications cloud de leur entreprise à l'aide des identifiants de leur compte Google géré.
